title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the Apps edit, Containers edit, and…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a critical vulnerability where an authenticated user with specific edit and execute permissions can exploit the App Wizard to run arbitrary code as the Splunk SOAR service user. This flaw arises from improper validation of user-supplied identifiers in the App Wizard, risking full compromise of the system's confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
